_comment: Regauntless equipment — weapons & armor transcribed VERBATIM from SRD 3.5 (OGL). Like feats/skills/bestiary: each entry has an 'srd' block (verbatim table row: cost/damage/crit/range/weight/type/special for weapons; cost/AC/maxDex/ACP/ASF/speed/weight for armor) + a 'regauntless' interpretation layer. WIRING: weapon damage dice + crit feed combat.md DETERMINISTIC damage (take-10 / max / min resolution) and the hero shot/melee swing; crit range/multiplier is relevant only in Gremlin mode (the optional d20 roll-to-hit variant). Armor rows feed the AC / armor-mitigation model (combat-model.md) — armor bonus, maxDex cap, and the speed penalty are the knobs; arcane-spell-failure/armor-check-penalty are sheet-level numbers that mostly tie to skills.json. Thrown/ranged weapons feed the projectile/shot system; melee feeds the swing. Transcribed faithfully, every row (incl. ammunition lines, shields, and armor 'Extras'). Validate JSON after every edit.

weapons.name: string
weapons.kind: melee | ranged | thrown (ranged = projectile/bow/crossbow; thrown = has a thrown range increment; ammunition is tagged kind:'ranged')

srd.damageSmall: string (verbatim Dmg (S); double weapons use 'X/Y'; '—' if none)
srd.rangeIncrement: string | null (verbatim, e.g. '10 ft.', '120 ft.'; null if melee-only '—')
srd.weight: string (verbatim Medium weight, e.g. '4 lb.', '½ lb.', 'special')
srd.special: string | null (short note of the weapon's special feature, or null)

regauntless.note: string — how it maps to our model

srd.acBonus: int (armor or shield bonus; tower shield is 4)
srd.maxDex: int | null (null for '—' / no cap, i.e. shields & extras)
srd.armorCheckPenalty: int (0 or negative; extras may use a string 'Special')

regauntless.note: string — how it maps to our model
